title: E-Commerce Product Search
short_description: Learn how e-commerce platforms search, organize and filter millions of products efficiently.

real_world_context.problem: An e-commerce platform may have thousands or millions of products. Customers need to find products quickly, browse products in a useful order, filter products by price, and identify combinations of products that fit a budget.
real_world_context.why_it_matters: Efficient searching and sorting allow an e-commerce platform to respond quickly even when the product catalog becomes very large.

learning_objectives: Understand how a product catalog can be represented using arrays.
Understand the difference between linear search and binary search.
Understand why sorting can make searching more efficient.
Recognize when the two-pointer technique can be applied.
Understand how algorithm choice affects performance as data size increases.
completion_message: You have completed the E-Commerce Product Search mission. You have learned how searching, sorting and array-based techniques can be applied to common e-commerce problems.
